about.intro: MERN Stack Developer passionate about building scalable and efficient software solutions.
about.title: About Me
about.p1: With {years}+ years of experience in web development, I specialize in building robust, scalable and user-centric web applications using the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express.js, React, Node.js). My expertise covers the entire development lifecycle, from designing clean RESTful APIs and efficient back-end logic to crafting responsive, interactive front-end interfaces.
about.p2: I am passionate about clean code, test-driven development and writing maintainable, high-performance applications. Whether it’s an e-commerce system, an e-book platform or workflow automation, I bring a problem-solving mindset and a keen eye for detail to every project.
about.p3: Outside of work, I contribute to open-source projects and mentor junior developers, helping them grow and succeed in their careers. I believe in continuous learning and always stay up to date with the latest trends in the JavaScript ecosystem.

delivery.q: When does the delivery time start?
delivery.a: The delivery time starts once I have your project details and any materials I need, such as text, images, logo or access.

revisions.a: A revision is an adjustment within the agreed scope. New features or a change of direction are quoted separately.

payment.a: Payment terms are agreed with you before work starts. No online payments are taken on this website.

custom.q: Can I request something outside the packages?
custom.a: Yes. Send me your requirements and I will prepare a custom quote.

a.q: Do you provide hosting and a domain?
a.a: Hosting and domain setup can be arranged on request. Fees charged by hosting and domain providers are paid by you directly.

b.q: Will my website work on mobile devices?
b.a: Yes. Every website is built to be responsive and tested on common screen sizes.

a.q: Which payment methods can be integrated?
a.a: Popular gateways such as Stripe and PayPal can be integrated, depending on your country and business type. Availability depends on the provider.

b.a: Yes. You will be able to add, edit and remove products from an admin area.

a.q: Which theme and plugins do you use?
a.a: I choose reliable, well-maintained themes and plugins that match your needs. Any premium licences are paid by you.

b.q: Can I edit the content myself?
b.a: Yes. You will be able to update pages and posts yourself, and I can share short instructions.

a.q: Is the advertising budget included in the price?
a.a: No. The price covers my service only. The advertising spend is paid directly to the platform.

b.a: Nobody can honestly guarantee rankings or sales. I focus on proven practices, clear tracking and transparent reporting.

a.q: Which file formats will I receive?
a.a: Final files are delivered in common formats such as PNG, JPG and PDF. Editable source files are included where the package lists them.

b.q: Can you work with my brand guidelines?
b.a: Yes. Share your logo, colours and fonts and I will follow them.

a.q: Can you fix a website you didn’t build?
a.a: In most cases, yes. I review the site first and tell you what is possible before starting.

b.q: Do you need access to my website?
b.a: Yes, I need the access required for the task, for example hosting or admin login. Please share it only through a secure channel.
